### Epic completion criteria

- [ ] Every child story has acceptance evidence and review.
- [ ] Relevant release gates, permissions and domain invariants are verified.
- [ ] Synthetic, observed and verified results are clearly identified.

### Accepted delivery scope

All nine child stories are closed for the local synthetic procurement workflow implemented in main. Real paid-sample production, reviewed legal/tax documents, physical logistics, provider reconciliation and production pilot authorization remain upstream backlog gates. This checklist synchronization does not mark those upstream stories complete.
